source: hi can U make a dress up game where there is a VIP area and U must use robux to go in and it cost 221 robux and a free area for all players and can U make rankings and make a runway after 10 minutes to dress up

answers.ask: No look was stated - should this read as glossy pink fashion-show, or a sleeker modern catwalk?
answers.answer: Make it a glossy pink fashion-show style, since it is a dress-up game with a runway.

answers.ask: Is the VIP area a separate room you walk into, or a fenced-off part of the same open space? Going inside adds a slower build step.
answers.answer: Make the VIP area a fenced-off part of the same open space, with entry locked behind the 221 Robux purchase.

## Clarifications resolved
- [author] theme — Q: No look was stated - should this read as glossy pink fashion-show, or a sleeker modern catwalk? A: Make it a glossy pink fashion-show style, since it is a dress-up game with a runway.
- [author] shape — Q: Is the VIP area a separate room you walk into, or a fenced-off part of the same open space? Going inside adds a slower build step. A: Make the VIP area a fenced-off part of the same open space, with entry locked behind the 221 Robux purchase.
- [agent_inferred] enclosure — Q: Is this an outdoor plaza or one open-plan venue? A: Use one medium open-plan fashion-show venue.

## Enriched image prompt
Create one glossy pink open-plan 3D fashion-show venue. Place a central judging runway with audience space around it and connect its entrance end to a large free dressing area available to all players. Beside the free area, create a smaller VIP dressing zone enclosed by a visible decorative fence and one controlled entry gate, without turning it into a separate room. Add a prominent rankings wall where it can be seen from the runway and gathering space, plus composed fashion-photo backdrops along the venue edges. Keep the free area, VIP enclosure, runway, audience area, and rankings wall legible together in one elevated view.

## Genre
The dominant genre is Roleplay & Avatar Sim (`roleplay-avatar-sim`), specifically Dress Up, with Party & Casual (`party-casual`) secondary for timed runway rankings.

## Shape and preset
Use `stage-runway`, with preparation areas feeding one judging catwalk and audience zone. The matching preset is Dress Up.

## Config requirements
Use `social-hub` for the roomy free dressing and gathering area. Use `vignette-photo` for glossy pink fashion-photo backdrops. Use `tracker-leaderboard`, taken from the Party & Casual options, for the visible rankings wall. Use `gate-progression`, taken from the shared catalogue, for the single physical gate in the VIP fence; its scene-specific lock is the stated purchase. The runway, audience area, dressing fixtures, and VIP fence remain scene geometry.

## Layout requirements
For `tracker-leaderboard`, place one rankings tracker on the prominent wall visible from both runway and gathering area. Place one free-text StartPoint marker at the preparation end of the catwalk. The 221 Robux gate rule and ten-minute dressing interval are purchase and timing logic rather than additional spatial objects.

## Layout components
The single venue contains a large free dressing zone, a smaller fenced VIP dressing zone, one entry gate, one central runway, audience ground around the runway, one rankings wall, and several edge backdrops. Clear circulation links both dressing zones to the runway entrance while the VIP fence prevents access from other sides. The venue boundary encloses one readable open floor.

## Render order
Use `isometric`: the glossy fashion-show appearance and relationship between runway, dressing zones, and audience lead, then the simple plan is derived.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Scale is medium, driven by two dressing areas, a runway, and audience space within one venue. The theme is a glossy pink fashion show. Use `P0`; all activity shares one single-level open-plan interior with no outside transition or separate stage map.
